The '''Deepest Woods''' was the name given to the southern half of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], between the [[Twisted Forest]] to the north and the uncorrupted [[Sha-Thes Meadow]] to the south beyond the black stone borders of the region. The [[Cave of Reflection]] was one of several caves located in the area's deep ravines, and the [[Char-An Commando Outpost]], the only stable outpost within the Nightmare Lands themselves, was located there.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deepest Woods appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
